scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n bridge,studio,desktop -c yellow,cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @tapmakerwork/bridge" "npm run dev -w @tapmakerwork/studio" "npm run dev -w @tapmakerwork/desktop"
scripts.dev:web: concurrently -k -n bridge,studio -c yellow,cyan "npm run dev -w @tapmakerwork/bridge" "npm run dev -w @tapmakerwork/studio"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @tapmakerwork/protocol && npm run build -w @tapmakerwork/bridge && npm run build -w @tapmakerwork/studio && npm run build -w @tapmakerwork/desktop
scripts.test: npm run test -w @tapmakerwork/protocol && npm run test -w @tapmakerwork/bridge
